public.prompt: Complete the masked manipulation plan in robotics_barrier_v1: target_world_position=<MASK>, safe_waypoints=<MASK>, grasp_precondition=<MASK>. Recover the target from calibrated numeric camera evidence and sense the full-height wall to choose an open passage. Read the workspace, robotics manual and barrier profile. The final route is checked in a symbolic 3D simulator; any behaviorally valid plan is accepted.

target_world_position.description: Recovered target location in world metres.

safe_waypoints.description: 0-16 intermediate world points; straight segments connect them.

grasp_precondition.description: Exactly gripper='open' and force_limit_n within the observed material's valid range.

camera.description: Observe calibrated fiducials and visible object projections; coordinates only, not images.

lidar.description: Observe obstacle boxes in the calibrated world frame.

probe_path.description: Non-destructively check a proposed path for collision/bounds; no target correctness feedback.

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.
